name: 90013 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90013 (Los Angeles) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90013 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
